text:
erin: Heads-up: small change to router routing priorities to prefer console-edge for small payloads. Affects API and runtime header routing. Window: Wed 03:30-03:50 UTC. Need pins and a short canary.
chao: Can you list the exact routing rule change and the expected behavior differences? Want to check for request stickiness effects.
erin: Rule: add priority rules so requests with header `X-Client-Edge: console` go to console-edge pool first. Router -> 3.5.2, API -> 1.14.9 (no code change), runtime flag `--prefer-console-edge=true`.
lex: Rollback plan please. If we see increased 5xx or session-sticky misses, we should revert router and unset flag.
erin: Rollback cmds: `deployctl traffic swap --service router --from 3.5.2 --to 3.5.1 --instant` and `deployctl feature unset --service runtime --flag prefer-console-edge`
deploy-bot: pin created: {service: router, version: "3.5.2", window: "2026-06-09T03:30:00Z/2026-06-09T03:50:00Z"} :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: pin created: {service: api, version: "1.14.9", window: "2026-06-09T03:30:00Z/2026-06-09T03:50:00Z"} :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Quiet-window scheduled at 03:20 UTC. Autoscaler warmup disabled for 10m. Alert rule: router/5xx > 4/min or session/sticky_miss_rate > 1% -> notify #eng-oncall and this thread.
qa-bot: Preflight smoke queued: console-edge-route-check, api-session-stability, runtime-kv-smoke.
lex: Starting 5% canary for runtime flag and router slice. I will run smoke at +3m.
deploy-bot: runtime flag staged to 5% canary; router 5% -> 3.5.2.
qa-bot: quick smoke: console-edge-route-check shows 99/100 requests routed to console-edge when header present. api-session-stability ok.
chao: Monitoring sticky_miss_rate closely.
ops-bot: metric watch created: session/sticky_miss_rate > 0.8% -> page oncall and post here.
lex: Proceeding to 25% at 03:36 if no regressions.
deploy-bot: runtime scaled to 25% canary; router traffic to 25% by lex at 03:36 UTC.
qa-bot: smoke after 2m: session/sticky_miss_rate at 1.4% on a subset of customers using legacy session tokens. Seeing session binds drop for ~2% of requests.
chao: That's higher than expected. Which clients? Looks like mobile-sdks v2.1 and some internal test runners.
erin: We didn't expect mobile SDKs to set X-Client-Edge header. They rely on sticky session via cookie; preferring console-edge might break their affinity in some edge cases.
lex: Recommendation: rollback router to 3.5.1 and revert runtime flag. We can't risk live user session drops.
deploy-bot: traffic swap executed: router 3.5.2 -> 3.5.1 by lex at 03:41 UTC.
deploy-bot: runtime feature unset: prefer-console-edge removed.
ops-bot: Alerts cleared. session/sticky_miss_rate back to baseline.
qa-bot: re-run smoke: session stability restored, console routing unchanged.
erin: Posting follow-ups: 1) add preflight test simulating mobile-sdks v2.1, 2) update release notes with fallback guidance, 3) consider gradual gate that checks session_miss by customer segments.
chao: I'll open ticket ENG-9123 for mobile SDK compatibility tests and add it to next sprint.
erin: Summary: attempted console-edge preference change, pinned services, staged canary 5/25, observed session-sticky regressions for legacy mobile SDKs, rolled router back to 3.5.1 and removed runtime flag. Closing window and scheduling follow-up.
lex: Thanks everyone — will add a brief blameless note to release notes. :thumbsup:
